card.name: Bible references and biblical narrative
card.fires_on: Punctuation or small words like "the", "to" and "(" inside Bible passages: verse citations (Num., Lk., Kings) and retellings of biblical stories, where a scripture name or verse number is likely next.

modes.label: Verse citations
modes.description: Periods, commas or opening brackets in or just before a scripture reference.

modes.label: Biblical narrative
modes.description: Small words like "the" or "to" in summaries of biblical stories, people and places.
modes.example: Numbers includes a narrative of the Israelite wanderings from Mount Sinai to<< the>> east side of the Jordan River.

card.writes: It pushes toward Bible-related words such as Bible and passages, and away from names like Peter, Samuel and Timothy.
card.plain: It activates in religious text that cites or retells Bible passages, especially around verse references.
